runtime: Actual Lua 5.1 modules with mocked client APIs; no live-game purchases

results.name: Shopping has all six route choices and keeps them independent of Guide
Fixed target automatically shrinks with skill and does not become a moving +10
Goal completion clears obsolete shopping requirements and retains mail credits
Target and gain presets validate, clamp, and cap mode follows training
Profession dropdown preserves distinct mode and goal per profession
Guided follows primary skill bands without requiring reagent prices
All steps selects one guide/alternative path, never sums all alternatives
Live alternatives use the open profession, explaining forecast gaps and close
Bag-first ranking counts owned inventory once and differs from Cheapest
Mail delivery updates missing table without replacing the selected route
Missing-only view omits covered materials while Show all retains them
Auctionator export rebuilds current skills then sends only current missing quantities
Automatic updates defer while a purchase or native confirmation is unresolved
Popup works when main Guide is hidden; missing Auctionator or AH gives actionable states
Profit sale assumptions and scan outputs stay independent of the Guide
New trainer or learned-recipe events rebuild only the fixed goal and preserve credits
Opening an existing saved shopping plan adopts it without inheriting later Guide changes
Shopping button invokes installed Auctionator replicate scan and observes progress
Full scan respects configured summary method and never changes Auctionator settings
Full-scan completion uses refreshed database prices and automatically rebuilds the fixed goal
Auctionator cooldown and active confirmation block scans without bypassing them
Unsupported, absent or closed-house scan conditions retain lists and give actionable messages
Failed full scan keeps previous quotes and never reports successful completion
